# typeassert: assertion after if inside case clause (CaseClause search path)
typeassert {
	var x I
	x.M() == 1 -> x.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface{ M() int }
type m1 int

func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func f(x I) {
	switch 1 {
	case 1:
		if x.M() != 1 {
			return
		}
		_ = x
	}
}
-- stdout --

 			return
 		}

 		_ = x
